opening: I unexpectedly collapsed and lost consciousness.
My wife told me that I did not respond to her for several minutes.
Just before I fell down, my heart started racing.
I felt lightheaded right before the fall.
My wife mentioned that my arms and legs began to tremble after I collapsed.
I had a heart attack 1 year ago.
I've had high blood pressure for the past 15 years.
My father died from a heart attack at age 55.
